The '''''Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[platinum open access]] [[scientific journal]] covering [[matrix analysis]] and [[linear algebra]], together with their applications. It is published by the [[International Linear Algebra Society]] and its [[editor-in-chief]] is Vanni Noferini ([[Aalto University]]).

==Editors-in-chief==
The first editors-in-chief were [[Volker Mehrmann]] ([[Technische Universität Berlin]]; 1996–1999) and [[Daniel Hershkowitz]] ([[Bar-Ilan University]]; 1996–2010). Other former editors-in-chief are {{ill|Ludwig Elsner|de}} ([[Bielefeld University]]; 2010–2011), [[Bryan Shader]] ([[University of Wyoming]]; 2010–2019),  Michael Tsatsomeros ([[Washington State University]]; 2016–2022), and Froilán M. Dopico ([[Universidad Carlos III de Madrid]]; 2019-2025). The current editor-in-chief is Vanni Noferini ([[Aalto University]]; since 2025).<ref name="editorslist">{{cite web |url=https://journals.uwyo.edu/index.php/ela/about/editorialTeam |title=Editorial Team |website=Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra |access-date=2025-08-01}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
* [[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=2021-05-28}}</ref>
* [[Mathematical Reviews]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |issn=1081-3810 |title=Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra |access-date=2021-05-08}}</ref>
* [[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI/>
* [[Scopus]]<ref name=Scopus>{{cite web |url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/26394 |title=Source details: Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |work=Scopus Preview |access-date=2021-05-28}}</ref>
* [[Zentralblatt MATH]]<ref name=MIAR/>
According to the [[Journal Citation Reports]], the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 0.8.<ref name=WoS2020>{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter=Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
